status: accepted static partial; same-simulation queue pointer/type7 handler/producer unverified

source.method: Pinned original PE, V7 immutable captures, Capstone instruction boundaries, direct-call graph evidence; no runtime attach

findings.claim: A method stores result of allocator call RVA 0x77C230 at +0x160 of its RDI receiver; value is potentially nonnull, not guaranteed nonnull.
findings.limitation: Receiver class identity not qualified as hkpMultiThreadedSimulation.

findings.claim: Matching-looking release routine reads +0x160 of RDI, calls 0x77C240, then zeroes field using RSI (zeroed at 0x89C9D5; RSI is Win64 nonvolatile).
findings.limitation: Static call graph suggests common lifecycle convention but dynamic object identity is not captured.

findings.claim: Verified wrappers call init at 0x89C4F0 and cleanup at 0x89C990. A caller passes global factory return 0x89E5D0 directly to wrapper 0x89EA80.
findings.limitation: Virtual, indirect and tail-callers are not exhaustively enumerated.

findings.claim: Factory at 0x89E5D0 requests 0x1D8 bytes (472) for a globally held object. Separately, hkpWorld requests 0x200 bytes and constructs hkpMultiThreadedSimulation via 0x089ABC, storing pointer at world+0x10.
findings.limitation: These are separate construction paths; static evidence does not establish a pointer alias between them. Note 0x089ABC and 0x89C605 differ by over 8 MiB and must not be conflated.

findings.claim: Nearby-looking +0x160 64-bit writes at these RVAs use an RBP frame pointer derived from RSP and are stack-local, not qualified heap queue writes.
findings.limitation: RBP alias qualification is per unwind region; unqualified RBP may point to heap or stack and is not promoted.

findings.claim: Three bounded .text bands (RVA 0x1000..0xC00000) each had incomplete PE-unwind coverage. Summed decoded instruction rows across band runs: 282257 (not necessarily unique). Initial 52 syntactic non-RSP +0x160 writers reduced to 43 when RBP aliases with proven RSP ancestry were excluded.
findings.limitation: No exhaustive code coverage is claimed. Only three bands were checked; indirect writes, leaf methods, unqualified RBP registers and incomplete unwind decodes remain unresolved.

sourceIndex.note: Historical pre-RBP artifact is preserved unchanged; the current index includes qualified RBP-from-RSP frame-exclusion. Field offset comparisons are only syntactic leads.
